features.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt
features.desired_outcome: Add a brief narrative hint or welcome message at step 0 explaining how walking and enemy encounters work.
features.reason: First-time players need clearer introduction to movement and combat.

features.title: Route Discovery Log and Collector Milestones
features.desired_outcome: A menu section displaying collected items per route and rewarding completionists with unique cosmetic tints.
features.reason: Collectors need an in-game tracking mechanism for discoveries and completion.

features.title: Add Elite Enemy Encounters to Difficulty 3+ Routes
features.desired_outcome: Incorporate elite variants with distinct behavior profiles into higher-tier routes.
features.reason: Higher difficulty routes currently have sparse enemy pressure.

features.title: Coin Bundle Special for Route Completion
features.desired_outcome: Introduce a temporary marketplace special or route-incentive bonus to smooth out the coin threshold gap.
features.reason: Provide a bounded progression experiment without permanently altering baseline pricing.

features.title: High-Contrast UI Theme Option
features.desired_outcome: Add an optional high-contrast mode toggle in the settings menu.

features.title: Explicit Input Buffering Feedback for Obstacles
features.desired_outcome: Add explicit descriptive hints and prevent redundant damage when invalid movement collides with static hazards.
features.reason: Repeated walk commands against one obstacle can spam damage.

policy.accept_means: authorize staged implementation/validation; it does not authorize automatic merge or bypass tests
